name: font-size-field
title: Font size field
description: A font size you can type, step or pick: minus, a number with its unit and plus, joined to a menu of common sizes, the way editors draw it.
docs: value is a number in unit, and sizes is the ladder the list shows and the arrow keys walk: from 16 the up arrow goes to 18, not to 17. Shift with an arrow adds or takes away one step, Alt with the down arrow opens the list, and Enter or leaving the field checks what was typed and brings it into min and max. The number is a spin button read as 'Font size, 16 pixels'. The minus, plus and list buttons are not tab stops, so the whole control is one stop in a toolbar, and they announce the size they set.
